subject.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits to requestTimeoutMs

question: Should appServer.requestTimeoutMs intentionally be the single ceiling for both app-server RPC responses and TCP/Unix WebSocket upgrade establishment?
rationale: The patch fixes a real indefinite hang without adding config, but it changes the meaning of an existing operator setting and can reject previously successful slow upgrades.

options.title: Reuse request timeout
options.body: Approve one resolved app-server budget for both upgrade establishment and RPC waits, keeping the configuration surface lean.

options.title: Use an internal handshake bound
options.body: Keep requestTimeoutMs scoped to RPC waits and add a non-configurable transport-owned upgrade ceiling.

options.title: Add a separate setting
options.body: Expose an independent handshake timeout, accepting another compatibility-sensitive config surface.

recommendation.title: Reuse request timeout
recommendation.body: Approve one resolved app-server budget for both upgrade establishment and RPC waits, keeping the configuration surface lean.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature-history trail most directly connects this contributor to the app-server timeout and config contract being changed.
